import sys, os, time
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/explore")
from tj import Tj

def run(sess, home, keys, cols=120, rows=40, args="", fresh=True, keep=False, esc=False):
    t = Tj(home=home, cols=cols, rows=rows, args=args, sess=sess, fresh=fresh)
    n = 0
    for k in keys:
        if k in ("@cap", "@capE"):
            n += 1
            print(f"===== CAP {n} =====")

"""Measure dialog bounding box across terminal sizes."""
import sys, os, time, re
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/explore")
from tj import Tj

def bounds(cap, title):
    lines = cap.split("\n")
    top = None; left = None; right = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if title in l:
            # the ┌ immediately before title
            ti = l.index(title)
            c = l.rindex("┌", 0, ti)
            e = l.index("┐", ti)
            top, left, right = i, c, e
            break
    if top is None:
        return None
    # bottom: first row after top whose char at left is └
    bot = None
    for i in range(top+1, len(lines)):
        l = lines[i]
        if len(l) > left and l[left] == "└":
            bot = i
            break
    return dict(top=top, bot=bot, left=left, right=right,
                w=right-left+1, h=(bot-top+1) if bot is not None else None)

sizes = [(120,40),(119,39),(100,30),(80,24),(90,30),(60,20),(200,50),(150,45),(70,22),(50,18),(40,15),(30,12),(20,10),(240,60),(110,35),(84,28),(76,26)]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Attach-or-create tmux driver: lets me send keys to a long-lived session across bash calls.

Usage:
  python3 att.py --sess S --home H [--cols N --rows N] [--new] KEYS...
KEYS: literal text, ^KeyName, @cap, @capE, @sN.N, @styles:r0:r1 (style runs for row range)
"""
import os, subprocess, sys, time, shutil, argparse
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/explore")
from styles import runs

EXE = "/workspace/executable"

def sh(*a):
    return subprocess.run(a, capture_output=True, text=True)

def exists(sess):
    r = sh("tmux", "has-session", "-t", sess)
    return r.returncode == 0

def create(sess, home, cols, rows, args, fresh):
    if fresh and os.path.isdir(home):
        shutil.rmtree(home)
    os.makedirs(home, exist_ok=True)
    sh("tmux", "kill-session", "-t", sess)
    cmd = f"env HOME={home!r} TERM=xterm-256color {EXE} {args}; echo __TJEXIT_$?__; sleep 3000"
    sh("tmux", "new-session", "-d", "-s", sess, "-x", str(cols), "-y", str(rows), cmd)
    time.sleep(1.0)

def cap(sess, esc=False):
    a = ["tmux", "capture-pane", "-p", "-t", sess]
    if esc:
        a.insert(2, "-e")
    return sh(*a).stdout.rstrip("\n")

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--sess", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--home", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--cols", type=int, default=120)
    ap.add_argument("--rows", type=int, default=40)
    ap.add_argument("--args", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--new", action="store_true", help="recreate session + wipe home")
    ap.add_argument("--restart", action="store_true", help="recreate session, keep home")
    ap.add_argument("--delay", type=float, default=0.3)
    ap.add_argument("keys", nargs="*")
    o = ap.parse_args()
    if o.new:
        create(o.sess, o.home, o.cols, o.rows, o.args, True)
    elif o.restart or not exists(o.sess):
        create(o.sess, o.home, o.cols, o.rows, o.args, False)
    n = 0
    for k in o.keys:
        if k in ("@cap", "@capE"):
            n += 1
            print(f"===== CAP {n} =====")
            print(cap(o.sess, esc=(k == "@capE")))
            print(f"===== /CAP {n} =====")
        elif k.startswith("@styles"):
            parts = k.split(":")
            r0 = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 and parts[1] else 0
            r1 = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 and parts[2] else None
            n += 1
            print(f"===== STYLES {n} rows {r0}..{r1} =====")
            print(runs(cap(o.sess, esc=True), r0, r1))
            print(f"===== /STYLES {n} =====")
        elif k.startswith("@s"):
            time.sleep(float(k[2:]))
        elif k.startswith("^"):
            sh("tmux", "send-keys", "-t", o.sess, k[1:])
            time.sleep(o.delay)
        else:
            sh("tmux", "send-keys", "-t", o.sess, "-l", k)
            time.sleep(o.delay)
    print("===== FINAL =====")
    print(cap(o.sess))
    print("===== /FINAL =====")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
